column1: ## OWASP ZAP baseline scan rules file.
## Used by: .github/workflows/devsecops-pipeline.yml, job "07 · DAST — OWASP ZAP baseline"
## Format: <rule id><TAB><threshold: IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL><TAB>(<rule name — comment only>)
## We deliberately do NOT ignore missing-security-header findings or cookie
## flag findings — those are real, actionable findings this API currently
## has (see docs/VULNERABILITIES.md) and the whole point of this job is to
## report them. We only mute alerts that are pure informational noise for a
## JSON API with no browser-rendered frontend.
